idsse.single_match_rule: A one-match smoke fit is not independent validation. Freeze actual multi-match hashes and splits in a new appendix before any full-spell selection.
idsse.label_contract: BallStatus 0=D; status1 and possession1=H, possession2=A; otherwise X. DFL semantics differ from official possession definition.
idsse.full_spell: Only independently checked complete periods; never label-island ranking. Unknown coverage => null.

fallback.folds: heldout=i; unused calibration=(i+1)%4; train=other two matches
fallback.baseline: Saved V3 baseline per fold, no refit and no overwrite
fallback.F1: Train natural-weight Home HGB on strict known alive Home labels from existing observed schema2 caches. Keep V3 Alive and all decoder costs fixed. Test effect of removing class weights only.
fallback.F2: Train one natural-weight Alive HGB on Metrica Game3 period1 known event-proxy labels. Freeze each V3 Home, evaluate period2 as within-match chronological weak validation plus four SkillCorner heldout known-live subsets as cross-provider live false-dead diagnostics. Not an independent HAD match test.
fallback.N1: Build provider_neutral_features_v3 from public raw inputs: coordinates-only speeds, explicit observation contract. Before any training on new schema freeze rebuilt hashes and an additional single-mechanism comparison. Do not relabel old caches as schema3.
fallback.F1_retention: Experimental only: natural Home Brier improves >=3/4 heldout matches, mean HA macro decline <=0.005, no natural per-match partial HAD macro drop >0.01. Do not rank by full spell.
fallback.F2_retention: Experimental only if Metrica period2 proxy Alive Brier and D F1 improve without any SkillCorner match's known-live false-D rate worsening >0.01; otherwise revert. This is a diagnostic threshold, never full-HAD promotion.
fallback.stress: Existing raw-masked/recomputed ball-dropout cache; report separately, no extra tuning
fallback.cross_provider: Metrica sample Game3 only, already viewed development data; no fresh-test claim

promotion: No competition promotion without independent full HAD evidence, fresh sealed validation and team approval.
budget: 2 CPU threads; four F1 Home fits and one F2 Alive fit; no hyperparameter search. IDSSE training supersedes fallback priority if verified data arrives.
